model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the standard deviation of errors across different language families for two tasks, TARG and PERMUTE. The horizontal axis displays language family categories—Agglutinative, Baltic, Indo-Iranian, Romance, Slavic, and Uralic—listed alphabetically. The vertical axis represents standard deviation, ranging from 0.0 to 0.2, in increments of 0.02. For each language family, there are two bars presented side-by-side: a blue bar representing TARG and a red bar representing PERMUTE. Within the Agglutinative family, TARG shows a standard deviation of approximately 0.13, while PERMUTE is around 0.10. In the Baltic language family, the TARG bar reaches approximately 0.18, and the PERMUTE bar extends close to 0.08. The Indo-Iranian and Romance language families show values around 0.08 for TARG and 0.06 for PERMUTE. The Slavic family displays approximately 0.12 for TARG and 0.10 for PERMUTE, while the Uralic family shows approximately 0.15 for TARG and 0.10 for PERMUTE. No bars are visually emphasized, and the bars are arranged by language family in alphabetical order.
